column2: # 中文：aes(price) 将 price 映射到 x 轴；geom_histogram() 将连续数值分箱，并在 y 轴显示每箱房源数。
# English: aes(price) maps price to x; geom_histogram() bins the numeric values and displays listing counts on y.
# 中文：未指定 bins 或 binwidth 时采用默认分箱；控制台关于 bins 的提示通常是建议，不是执行失败。
# English: Without bins or binwidth, default binning is used; the bins message is usually advice rather than an execution failure.
# 中文：标题、副标题、轴标签和数据来源由 labs() 设置；副标题只是说明，真正的筛选已在前面完成。
# English: labs() sets title, subtitle, axes, and source; the subtitle is descriptive and the actual filtering was performed earlier.
# 中文：观察形状、集中位置和高价尾部；直方图的形状也受箱宽影响，不应只凭默认分箱下结论。
# English: Inspect shape, centre, and the high-price tail; appearance also depends on bin width, so avoid relying on default bins alone.
